title: The FULL RELEASE Is Here! | RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0
author: Mr Feudal
description:
RuneScape: Dragonwilds has officially entered 1.0!

This episode was recorded on September 15th, update day, so before continuing our adventure we're taking a moment to celebrate the full release and check out some of the new content arriving with Dragonwilds 1.0.

Alongside new items, enemies and spells, there's also new DLC bringing some incredibly recognisable RuneScape-inspired equipment into Dragonwilds. We've got Gilded Paladin armour, Gilded Capes, new furniture and companion placeables, giving us even more ways to customise both our character and our home.

But 1.0 arriving doesn't mean our existing adventure is finished.

Far from it.

Today we're heading back into the Black Fortress to continue hunting for the shattered pieces of the gemstone. We've already experienced just how dangerous this place can be, but if we're going to continue progressing our journey, we're going to have to venture back inside and find the remaining fragments.

So consider this episode a small celebration of everything RuneScape: Dragonwilds 1.0 brings to the game before we pick up our weapons and get straight back to business.

The Black Fortress awaits... and we're going back in.
